command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo="tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer"
$branch="work/high-contrast-acceptance"
$expected="bd13f3c68a12d3bdd111a0171a70f17ef3b6f8de"
$ref=("heads/"+$branch)
$encoded=[uri]::EscapeDataString($ref)
$obj=gh api ("repos/"+$repo+"/git/ref/"+$encoded) | ConvertFrom-Json
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "failed to resolve cleanup branch"}
if($obj.object.sha -ne $expected){throw ("cleanup branch moved: expected "+$expected+", got "+$obj.object.sha)}
gh api --method DELETE ("repos/"+$repo+"/git/refs/"+$encoded)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "cleanup branch delete failed"}
Write-Host ("DELETED_BRANCH="+$branch)
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS"
